name: Miyazato Takuji
source:
Main character of episode 2
[url=/c92659]Nishima[/url]'s subordinate. Being a GC license owner himself, Miyazato has a keen interest in [url=/c92638]Aruru[/url], who is currently holding a S-rank license (since he is also fond of her small body, one could refer to him as a lolicon)
He is also [spoiler][url=/c92658]Chisa[/url]'s close friend since school time. However, different from [url=/c92658]Chisa[/url], Miyazato doesn't want to get too involved with special powers. As a result, he keeps a distance from her in their relationship.[/spoiler]
